# Unrecorded Apple 1.3 fixtures

Synthetic fixtures based on Apple Container upstream structs, not output recorded from a running engine.
Version is a component array; status is an object. Fields beyond those consumed by the adapter are ignored.
Real volume durability, image-load output, exit state and networking require Owner-recorded fixtures/spike.
Observed public signature TeamIdentifier on the installed arm64 executable: UPBK2H6LZM.
